senses.gloss: (= עֲדַיִין; אַד = עַד a. יין = הֵין; h. עַד הֵנָּה) until now; whence, still, yet; as yet.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 4:3:13">Y. Ber. IV, 8ᵃ</cite> bot. <he>אין את לזו וא׳</he> art thou not yet up to this, i.e. dost thou not yet understand it? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Taanit 2:2:13">Y. Taan. II, 65ᶜ</cite> bot. <he>א׳ את לזו</he>.

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Gittin 9:9:3">Y. Git. IX, end, 50ᵈ</cite> <he>וא׳ את ליי</he> art thou still at that point, i.e. dost thou still ask? <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Peah 1:1:22">Y. Peah I, 15ᶜ</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kiddushin 1:7:13">Y. Kidd. I, 61ᵇ</cite> top <he>וא׳ לחצי וכ׳</he> and yet he has hardly come up to half the honor due to parents.
